item.title: Night to Shine rolls out red carpet for special guests at Grace Baptist
item.description: For one night, 75 people with special needs got the full celebrity treatment — red carpet, limo rides, flowers, hair styling and a crowning ceremony at the end of the evening.Grace Baptist Church in Batavia hosted its second annual Night to Shine on Friday, an event sponsored by the Tim Tebow Foundation that transforms the church into a prom-like celebration for individuals with special needs ages 14 and up.

item.title: GLOW Community Alliance hosts vigil and 'ICE Out' rally Sunday
item.description: Press ReleaseOn Sunday, Feb. 15, communities nationwide gather simultaneously to demonstrate against the violence of ICE, Customs and Border Protection, and other federal agencies.The GLOW Community Alliance will accompany a vigil with an "ICE Out" rally beginning at 3 p.m. where Federal Drive meets Route 98 in Batavia
